Cada número tem um cartão. No alto apare: Each number has a card. The top shows the name the team gave the number and its phone number. The green "Connected" badge means it is receiving and sending messages. Just below, after "Verified", you see the date and time the system last checked the number. "Not verified yet" means the system has never managed to check it. Farther down, the card says which team members receive conversations from this number. Use "Configure assignees by number" to choose them. "Keep history from before linking" is off by default, so only new messages come in. Changing it restarts the number for a few seconds, and turning it off for an already connected number may delete what it has stored.
O \"Push\" de \"Nova mensagem\" é a chav: The "New message" Push switch controls all notifications outside the site on this device: when off, no other notification reaches the notification tray and the other Push switches are locked. Individual Push switches only apply while the site is open; when it is closed, only this main switch applies. In the image, the browser is blocking notifications. That is why the row says "The browser blocked notifications" and the Push column is dimmed: the switches may look on, but they have no effect and cannot change while the browser blocks them. To allow them, click the icon to the left of the site address (a padlock or two short lines), allow notifications, and reload the page.
A tabela compara as pessoas da equipe no: The table compares team members over the last 30 days; "(you)" identifies the person using the screen. "Won" and "Lost" count closed deals assigned to that person. "Conversations" counts conversations handed to them. "1st response" is the time between the customer's first message and the first reply written by a team member, in conversations assigned to that person. The average includes all response times; the median is the middle value. In Helena's row, the average is much higher than the median: one slow reply taking hours pulls the average up, while the median shows the typical response. Times are in minutes: 120min means 2 hours.
A frase do alto avisa que a ligação é só: The sentence at the top says the connection is read-only: the system reads campaign performance and displays it under "Analytics" on the Meta Ads screen, but nothing is created, paused, or changed in your ad account. The blue box explains what you need: an access token, a special password Facebook generates so the system can read your ads. Generate the token on the Meta for Developers site, inside an app in your Meta developer account. When generating it, select the "ads_read" permission (this allows the system to read ads). If another person or agency manages your ads, ask them for the token.
Cada linha é um evento. \"Quando\" diz h: Each row is an event. "When" says how long ago it happened. "Action" is the event code in English: "auth.login_success" means signing in, and "conversation.transferred" means a transferred conversation. "Tenant" is the short name of the company where it happened. "Actor" is the ID of whoever did it, and "Resource" is the type of item affected, with the beginning of its ID. A dash means that information does not exist: no company (such as a sign-in, or when the company has been deleted) or no person (when the system itself or an integration connected with an access key performed the action).
O quadro amarelo no topo diz o que esta: The yellow box at the top says what this installation can do. In the image, it says notifications only appear while the site is open in a tab: the server keys are missing, and the server administrator can fix this by running the installation update, which creates those keys. If your box mentions a secure connection (https), the server administrator needs to connect a domain with https. If it says notifications already work "even with the tab closed", nothing is missing. "Receive on your phone: install the app" opens the instructions for putting the system on your phone.
Em \"Como este número distribui\", escol: Under "How this number distributes conversations", choose "Automatic rotation among support staff". The rule applies only to this number; others follow the organization rule. Note: with a custom rule, only the people you select below receive customers from this number. Once a rule is selected, "Default destination assignee" becomes available: if you select someone, every new customer from this number goes straight to them, bypassing distribution. If they are unavailable or at capacity, the conversation waits for them and does not go to someone else.
As duas frases debaixo dos campos resume: The two sentences below the fields summarize the rule. The first says who it covers: the selected role and every role above it. The second explains the deadline: nobody is blocked during the grace period; afterward, anyone covered who has not activated verification sees a locked screen until they set it up. The period starts when the rule changes or when the person joins the company, whichever is later. Changing the rule again therefore restarts everyone's countdown. Clicking "Save" saves the rule and reloads the page with the new choice in the fields.
A Agenda mostra os compromissos da clíni: The Calendar shows the clinic's appointments: consultations, sessions, and team meetings. Below "Appointments" are arrows to change weeks and view buttons. Next comes the appointment list, organized in tabs, followed by the weekly grid, with a colored block for each appointment. At the top, "Google synchronization is not available yet" appears while the installation has no Google connection configured. The Calendar works normally without it; it just does not exchange appointments with Google Calendar.
Ligada, esta chave faz o sistema recusar: When on, this switch makes the system reject every message from WhatsApp connected by QR code that arrives without the connection's secret signature. It is off by default because not every WhatsApp server signs messages: enabling it when the server does not sign blocks incoming messages. Below, the screen reports whether recent messages arrived signed. If no message arrived in the last week, it says "No WhatsApp deliveries in the last week to check the signature." When "Safe to enable: WhatsApp already signs messages." appears, it is safe to turn it on.
O selo \"Publicado\" quer dizer que o ag: The "Published" badge means the agent is live: new WhatsApp messages go to it. "Draft" means it is not handling conversations because it has not been published yet or was paused. The "default" badge identifies the company's default agent. Below its name are the current AI provider and model. "Priority" shows the preference order, which only matters when there is more than one agent. "Type" displays an internal system code: it is for information only; you do not need to change it.
O cartão \"Por canal\" tem uma linha par: The "By channel" card has a row for each WhatsApp number that handled conversations in the last 30 days; numbers with no activity in that period do not appear. "Conversations" counts conversations handed to a team member during that period. "1st response (average)" is the average time until the first reply written by a person. "Unanswered" counts how many of those conversations still have no reply from a team member. An archived number with activity during the period still appears, marked "(archived)".
O cartão 'Primeira cobrança: o que falta: The 'First payment: what is missing' card is your to-do list. Completed steps are crossed out with a check mark. Incomplete steps explain what to do. The next pending step gets a 'Do it now' link when there is a specific place to complete it. Here, email sending still needs configuring and, last, you need to switch to the production key. The yellow "No SMTP configured" banner at the top is a general Admin warning: email sending is not configured yet. The "Email" menu item opens the settings.
No fim do quadro, ao lado dos botões, um: At the bottom of the box, next to the buttons, a sentence says how email is currently being sent. Here it says no delivery method is configured. In this case, whoever invites someone to the team receives a link to copy and send to them, instead of the invitation arriving in their inbox. Once your own server is saved with the address and sender email filled in, the sentence changes to "In use: email is being sent through this server." If email goes through the external service, it says so.
Clique no papel de uma pessoa para trocá: Click a person's role to change it. "Read-only" can view without handling conversations. "Support staff" handles conversations. "Manager" also monitors the team and adjusts support settings. "Administrator" can do everything in this company, including inviting and removing people. The change applies as soon as you select it, with no save button. Note: anyone changed to "Read-only" stops handling conversations, and their open conversations return to the Queue. The system does not allow you to demote the last Administrator.
O campo \"Token de acesso\" recebe o tok: The "Access token" field takes the token you generated. The gray "EAA…" is only an example of its beginning: the field is empty. The same applies to the gray "act_123456789012345" in the field below. "Default account (optional)" determines which ad account the Meta Ads screen opens first. Until a token is pasted into the field, "Save" stays dimmed and "Paste the token to save." appears. If you pasted it and the warning remains, the token was cut off: copy the entire token again.
A tela \"Solicitações LGPD\" mostra os p: The "LGPD requests" screen shows customers' requests about their own data. They only arrive here if your Nuvemshop store is connected to the CRM: when a store customer requests a copy of their data or asks to be deleted, the store sends the request here and the deadline starts running. Requests made by WhatsApp or phone do not appear in this list. To delete that person, open their record in Contacts and use "Anonymize contact". Clínica Bem Viver has its store connected and four requests.
O quadro \"Linha do tempo SLA\" mostra a: The "SLA timeline" box shows the deadline bar (green at first, yellow from three-quarters onward, red at the end) and the stages "Received" (D+0), "Intermediate review" (D+5), and "Delivery to the data subject" (D+7). These stages count calendar days: the actual deadline is "Due on" at the top of the page. "Details" shows the type, source ("nuvemshop" is the online store), how many attempts the system has made, and the customer's store ID, shown as "External customer ID".
Ligue \"Receber também no WhatsApp\" e d: Turn on "Also receive on WhatsApp" and enter your number using digits only, starting with Brazil's 55 and the area code, as requested by "Number with area code, digits only". It saves when you leave the field. The message is sent through the company's WhatsApp number, and only when it is connected. It contains only the task name and appears in the inbox as a conversation with your contact. Your number must be registered as a contact in the system: otherwise, the reminder stays in the Notification Center only.
Logo acima da grade fica a linha \"Horár: Just above the grid is "Available times for", with a button for each appointment type. The selected type determines which times the grid offers: its duration and the working hours of the person providing the service. Here, "Physical therapy session", handled by Ana, is selected. When no time is available in the period, "No available times in this period." appears. If the provider has not published their working hours yet, it says "The service schedule has not been published yet."
Clique na chave. Ela salva na hora, sem: Click the switch. It saves immediately, with no save button, and "Option saved." appears briefly in a corner of the screen. The sentence below now starts with "On:". When on, if the customer's record has no phone number and the AI agent notes the number they provided, it is saved immediately. If the customer has an open deal, this is recorded in its history. An existing phone number is never replaced automatically: that still requires a person.
Cada linha é um pedido. \"ID\" é o códig: Each row is a request. "ID" is the short request code. "Type" says what was requested: "Data request" (the customer wants a copy of their data), "Customer anonymization" (the customer wants their data anonymized), or "Tenant anonymization" (the company uninstalled the Nuvemshop store app, and all its customers' data will be anonymized). "Tenant" is the company that received the request. "Received" says how long ago it arrived.
A aba 'Régua' diz o que acontece com uma: The 'Collection schedule' tab explains what happens to a company that has not paid. 'Grace days' is how long it has before suspension. The list below shows the schedule: on day 0, the first notice goes out with the payment link, followed by the final notice and then suspension. Notices appear inside the company's system and, if email sending is configured, also arrive by email. When payment is confirmed, the company resumes operation automatically.
No fim de cada linha ficam até três atal: Up to three shortcuts appear at the end of each row. The speech bubble opens this customer's conversation in the Inbox. If the customer has a phone number but has never had a conversation, the bubble starts a new Inbox conversation so you can write first. This requires a WhatsApp number connected under "Connections". With no phone number and no conversation, the bubble does not appear. The pencil edits the record without leaving the list, and the trash icon deletes the contact. Clicking the name opens the full customer record.
Mais abaixo, na aba \"Configuração\", fi: Farther down the "Configuration" tab is "Unreported conversions": ad sales whose delivery has not yet been confirmed by the platform. Next to the title is the number of conversions the platform has already accepted. Each row shows the deal, event, source, value, what happened (with instructions on what to do), when it happened, and a retry button. Only the latest 20 appear; to see them all, use "Delivery history".
Os alertas \"IA Budget\" aparecem quando: "AI Budget" alerts appear when a company's accumulated spending reaches 80% or more of the cap. Here, FisioMove is at 92% and NutriVida at 87%, both marked "Warning". FisioMove chose monitoring only; NutriVida chose to stop AI at the limit. The alert's accumulated spending does not prove AI has stopped: the limit uses this month's spending. Click NutriVida's row to check that figure on the health page in the next step.
A parte \"Contato\" mostra telefone e e-: "Contact" shows the negotiating person's phone and email; "Links" holds Instagram, website, and other addresses. "Open in WhatsApp" opens WhatsApp on your computer or phone, outside the system: to keep the conversation stored here, prefer "Open conversation in Inbox". "View full contact record" opens the contact screen. Under "Related people", "Add participant" links others to the deal, such as the person paying.
A lista fica logo acima da grade e tem q: The list sits just above the grid and has four tabs: "Upcoming", "Awaiting confirmation", "Past", and "Canceled". Each tab's number says how many appointments it contains. The list follows the period on screen: here, we moved one week ahead with the right arrow to see what is coming. Each row shows the date, time, customer name (or appointment name if there is no customer), provider, and status.
Aqui buscamos \"Joa\" com a etiqueta \"r: Here we searched "Joa" with the "follow-up" tag still enabled. No conversation matches both, so "No conversations match these filters" appears, followed by the active filters ("Active: Search · Tag"). The inbox is not empty: the filters are hiding conversations. The "1" next to "All" is Fernanda: she has the tag but does not match the "Joa" search. Searching does not change that number.
Com uma cor bem clara, como este amarelo: With a very light color like this yellow, text on buttons would be hard to read. In light mode, the system therefore uses a darker shade from the same scale. In dark mode, your color is used as is. The sentences under "Where everything comes from" explain this. The last sentence, in orange, notes that this yellow is similar to the system's error color: check that error notices remain easy to distinguish.
No topo ficam o nome, o e-mail, o telefo: The top shows the name, email, phone, and tags. "Mark as personal" removes the contact from customer support: conversations close and AI, automatic follow-ups, campaigns, and sends stop. "Mark as always human" stops AI replying to this customer until someone clicks "Remove human-only flag". Both ask for confirmation first. "Edit" opens the edit window with additional custom fields.
\"Razão social\" e \"CNPJ\" são opcionai: "Legal name" and "CNPJ" are optional; without a legal name, the system uses the display name. "Plan" (Standard, Pro, or Enterprise) is only an organizing label: it charges nothing and imposes no limits. If Billing is enabled on your server, "Billing plan" appears instead, and the selected plan really does charge. Under "Owner's email", enter the email of the person who will own the company in the system.
No Admin, o item \"API Oficial (Meta)\": In Admin, the "Official API (Meta)" menu item opens this screen. It stores two things: the secret key for the app you created in Meta, used to verify that every message received through the official number really came from Meta, and a verification token, used by Meta to confirm your server address. Both apply to the entire installation: each company connects its own number later under "Connections".
O item \"Configurações\", com o desenho: "Settings", with a gear icon, sits at the bottom of the left menu and appears on every screen. Clicking it opens this page, which lists all system settings screens. Each card has the screen name and a sentence explaining its purpose. The first group, "Your company", applies to the whole clinic: appointment types, team, branding, features you can turn on and off, plan, and more.
Cada campo tem o seu próprio botão \"Sal: Each field has its own "Save" button: type and click the button on the same row. "Done, it is now active." appears immediately. The input field becomes empty again, and "Now:" appears just above it with the saved value. The badge changes to "Set here on this screen" and a "Restore default" button appears. What you save here overrides anything in the server installation file.
O cartão \"WAHA\" mostra quantos canais: The "WAHA" card shows how many of the company's WhatsApp channels are connected out of the total. Here it is "0/1 connected": the only number is down, so the badge says "Critical". With no numbers, the badge says "Warning". "Nuvemshop" says whether the online store is connected and when access expires. A company without an online store appears as "Not connected", with a "Warning" badge: in that case, there is nothing to fix.
Escolha em \"Funil de destino\" para ond: Choose where customers will go under "Destination pipeline", then click "Choose CSV file". CSV is a spreadsheet format: in Excel, use File › Save As › CSV; in Google Sheets, File › Download › CSV. "Download spreadsheet template" downloads an example with the correct columns. At the end, the window shows how many cards were created, unrecognized columns, and rejected rows with their reasons.
Esta escolha vale só para quem tem o pap: This choice only applies to the Support staff role. Managers and administrators still see everything. With "Everyone sees everything", any support staff member can open any colleague's conversation and deal. With "Their own, plus unassigned", selected in a fresh installation, they see their own customers and the queue of new arrivals. With "Only their own", they see only what was assigned to them, without even the queue.
Em \"Escopos\" ficam as permissões. Cada: "Scopes" contains the permissions. Each button shows a short name and what it allows beside it. Click to select: selected buttons get a colored border. The medical record system only needs to look up patients, so select only "mcp:read". Although the description mentions AI agents, this permission lets any system read the CRM. Fewer permissions mean less damage if the key falls into the wrong hands.
Para ter certeza de que está tudo certo,: To check everything works, click "Send test lead". A contact named "Test Lead" enters the pipeline at the source's stage. On success, "View in Kanban" appears, and the submission appears under "Recent submissions". Note: the test is a real contact. Any automations triggered by new contacts, such as a welcome message, run for it too.
\"Editar\" muda título, valor, descrição: "Edit" changes the title, value, description, and expected date. "Assignee" transfers the deal to another person or an AI agent. "Mark as won" and "Mark as lost" close it. "Move to another pipeline" recreates the deal in another pipeline and closes this one as lost; with only one pipeline, the window says there is nowhere to move it. "Delete" removes the card, but the contact and conversations remain.
Toda mensagem que sai da empresa mostra,: Every outgoing company message shows its sender above it: "AI", with a small robot, for automatic support; "You" for what you wrote; "Support staff" for another team member; and "Phone" when someone replied through WhatsApp on their phone. Automatic reminders and follow-ups appear as "Automation". This lets you distinguish bot replies from messages written by a person.
Cada cartão é uma fonte. O selo verde \": Each card is a source. The green "Active" badge means it is accepting contacts. "Paused" means it rejects submissions: anyone completing that form will not enter the pipeline. Below the name is the time since the latest contact arrived, or "never received any" if none have arrived. A form that used to receive contacts daily but has been idle for a long time deserves a look.
\"Excluir tenant\" apaga a empresa e tod: "Delete tenant" permanently deletes the company and all its data: conversations, messages, leads, files, agents, and integrations. WhatsApp numbers are disconnected, and logins belonging to people who only worked at this company are removed; those participating in another company remain. To enable "Delete permanently", write the reason and type the company slug shown just above the field.
No alto ficam as duas decisões que andam: The top has two linked decisions. First, who receives a new customer: someone takes them from the queue or the system assigns them automatically. Second, what each support staff member sees: everything or just their own customers. The option with a colored border is currently active. In a fresh installation, nobody receives customers automatically, and support staff see their own customers plus unassigned ones.
Etiquetas são as marcas que ficam nos cl: Tags are labels on customers, pipeline deals, and conversations, such as "insurance" or "self-pay". This screen gathers all company tags alphabetically: those added manually by the team, those added by automatic rules, and those you created. Each row is a tag. Above the list are the total and current page; each page displays up to 100.
A coluna \"MFA\" fala da verificação em: The "MFA" column refers to two-step verification: a 6-digit code from a phone authenticator app in addition to the password. "Yes" means it is mandatory: until the person sets up the code, the system blocks access to both Admin and the rest of DeskComm. "No" means it is optional. Like everything else on this screen, this "Yes" or "No" can only be changed directly in the database.
O botão \"Pausar\" desliga o número sem: "Pause" stops the number without disconnecting it. While paused, incoming messages are stored but do not appear in the Inbox, AI does not reply, and nothing is sent through it. The card gets a "Paused" badge and the button becomes "Resume". Pausing does not reconnect the number: it still has the "Disconnected" badge. When resumed, stored messages appear in the Inbox without losing any.
Em \"Últimos recebimentos\" fica cada en: "Recent submissions" lists every submission received through this source, newest first. The first is the test you just ran. A green dot only means the submission arrived; a red one means its signature did not match. To check whether it became a lead, see "Leads received". The list updates automatically every 5 seconds while the panel is open.
No alto do Atrito fica a frase \"Contar: At the top of Friction is "Count as lost to silence after 72 hours without a reply". This determines when a conversation enters "Conversations that went silent" on the Conversion card. "(system default)" means the threshold is at its default, 72 hours. Clinics that normally wait less for a patient to reply may want a lower number.
Se a sua marca tem uma versão para fundo: If your brand has a version for dark backgrounds, enter it under "Your brand color in dark mode (optional)". Leave it blank to use the upper color in both modes. The caption below the scale, under "Buttons in dark mode", then follows this color. The code may differ slightly from what you entered because the system selects the shade that keeps button text readable.
Mais abaixo, o funil conta os negócios a: Below, the pipeline counts the open deals Ana can see: her own and unassigned ones. The table is called "Your performance" and has just her row: wins, losses, conversations, and first response time. "By channel" and "Wins by period" also count only what she can see, so their numbers are lower than the whole clinic's.
As duas caixas mostram como o logo fica: The two boxes show how the logo looks on the system's light and dark backgrounds. Without a custom logo, the name appears as text, as in the image. After uploading a logo, if there is no dark version, the dark preview shows it on a small white panel so a dark logo with a transparent background does not disappear. To avoid the panel, use "Logo for dark mode (optional)".
Antes de trocar, o sistema pergunta. O t: The system asks before replacing it. The current token immediately becomes invalid. Incoming messages keep arriving because they are verified using the secret key. If you pasted the token manually in Meta's panel, you must paste the new one there too. Otherwise, Meta cannot reconfirm your server address. "Cancel" closes without changing anything.
Ao clicar em \"Criar tipo\", o formulári: Clicking "Create type" closes the form and adds "Physical therapy follow-up" to the list with its category, duration, and location. Since Ana provides the service, the calendar already offers times of this type within her working hours. Two types cannot have the same name, even if the other is disabled: the system says it already exists. In that case, reactivate the old one.
O \"Atalho (opcional)\" é uma palavra cu: "Shortcut (optional)" is a short word to find the reply quickly: in the Inbox, with an empty message field, type / and the shortcut (here, /pix), then click the reply in the list. Turn on "Share with the team" so everyone can use it; off, it is yours only. This cannot change after creation. Finally, click "Create quick reply".
Marque \"Avisar o cliente antes do compr: Select "Notify the customer before the appointment via WhatsApp". Choose how far in advance (here, 1 day) and write the message. Words in braces, such as {{nome}} and {{hora}}, are replaced with each customer's details when sent. A blank message uses the system default. The reminder only goes out if the clinic has a connected, working WhatsApp number.
O quadro \"Seu plano\" mostra o nome do: "Your plan" shows the company's subscribed plan and its monthly cost (or yearly cost for an annual plan). Below is a brief payment status. "Up to date" means everything is paid. When anything changes, the sentence changes too: "Overdue since" a date, "Canceled, access until" a date, or "Free trial until" a date.
Clique em \"Configurar acesso da IA\", n: Click "Configure AI access" on the Physical Therapy card. A panel opens on the right. Under "Numbers authorized for testing", enter the phone numbers allowed to talk to AI, one per line, including country code (+55) and area code. Use numbers belonging to your team or trusted people. The gray number in the empty box is only an example.
A aba \"Chamada de voz\" liga as chamada: The "Voice call" tab enables WhatsApp voice calls. It depends on a service the system installation administrator must configure. Until then, the tab says "Voice calling is not configured." The line below is a technical message for the installation administrator. You do not need to understand it, just pass it along.
O plano mudou? Volte em Configurações, \: Has the plan changed? Return to Settings, "Sales target". The field already shows the current target. Change the number and click "Save target" again: "Target saved." flashes and disappears, and this month's target is corrected without creating another. Here Helena lowered it from 20 to 15 because a physical therapist went on vacation. A target can only be corrected, not deleted.
Clicando em \"Ver\" numa linha, abre a f: Clicking "View" in a row opens the person's record. The top shows their name, email, and account ID. "User information" shows when their email was confirmed (or "Pending" if not), last access, account creation date, and "MFA": "Active" if they use two-step verification and "Inactive" if not.
Quem administra a instalação vê o link \: The installation administrator sees "Register Google credentials". The rest of the box, with the callback address, is for that person; anyone just using the Calendar can ignore it. Your installation shows your domain; the image shows this demonstration's address (127.0.0.1). After registration, the box is replaced by "Connect Google".
A aba \"Telefone\" lista os números que: The "Phone" tab lists numbers that receive calls. Each points to a voice agent and a service mode. Click "New number" to register one. Calls only arrive if the installation administrator has purchased and connected the phone line: registering it here alone does not make the phone ring. The example clinic has none yet.
Agora a lista mostra só os clientes com: The list now shows only customers with the selected tag, and the button highlights that tag. Tags appear as badges on each customer's row. With more than two, the extras become "+1", "+2"… Notice that the number next to "All" also dropped to 1: the tag changes tab counts, as does "Unread".
Num modelo da plataforma você tem \"Não: A platform template offers "Do not use" and "Customize": the original text stays unchanged, but you can make a clinic copy to edit. A company template offers "Edit" and "Remove". Lessons for "Do not use", "Customize", and "Edit" follow. "Remove" asks first and takes the template off the list. Previously sent proposals stay unchanged.
\"sem responsável — definir quem atende\: "unassigned — choose who provides the service" means nobody has been chosen for that type. Without this, the calendar has no times to offer for it, either in the booking screen or through the AI agent. Clicking the warning opens its settings immediately. A type marked "disabled" is dimmed: it disappears from booking options, but its history remains.
A última parte, \"Depende do servidor\",: The last section, "Depends on the server", only displays information; it enables nothing. These features need another service's password or a server setting, such as email sending. Each row's badge says "Configured" or "Not configured". If the screen cannot check, it says "Cannot check from here". No passwords appear here.
Agora veja \"Excluir\" na \"aguardando-e: Now see "Delete" for "awaiting-exam". The box has a yellow warning: 1 automatic rule still has an action to add this tag. Deleting it here does not delete the rule: if enabled, it will add the tag again next time it runs. In this case, click "Cancel" and first change the rule in "Webhooks", under "Automations".
Nos três pontinhos de um convite em aber: The three dots on an open invitation offer three options. "Resend" renews it for another 24 hours and tries emailing it again; this also works for expired invitations. "Copy link" copies the invitation link. "Revoke" cancels it: the person can no longer join through that link. Managers see this list, but only Administrators can change it.
Se o seu site não tem formulário, use o: If your site has no form, use the ready-made one. "Copy form" copies the code with your questions and the correct destination address. Paste it into a code area on your site or give it to your website administrator. For submitters to see a thank-you page, the source must have been created with "Thank-you URL" filled in.
A chave \"Disponível\" liga e desliga o: The "Available" switch turns each person's availability on or off immediately. Off, they do not receive conversations through automatic distribution but can still take conversations in the Inbox.
